title: LipSpell: A Language-Independent Phonetic Scoring Framework for Spelling Correction Combining Distinctive-Feature Edit Distance, Keyboard Geometry, and Corpus Frequency
abstract: arXiv:2611.24285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic spelling correction must handle both keyboard typographical slips and cognitive or phonetic misspellings where writers approximate a word's pronunciation. Conventional spell checkers rely either on orthographic edit distance and keyboard proximity--which struggle when phonetic errors diverge by multiple characters--or on English-centric phonetic hashes such as Soundex and Metaphone. We present LipSpell, a unified, language-independent phonetic scoring engine paired with swappable language-specific G2P frontends, keyboard maps, and lexicons integrating: (1) a precomputed |P|x|P| phone-distance matrix from universal IPA distinctive features, (2) physical keyboard geometry, and (3) corpus unigram frequency priors, accelerated by a two-stage symmetric-delete and seven-class phonetic-code index. translated_title: LipSpell：一种结合区别特征编辑距离、键盘几何与语料库频率的语言无关语音评分拼写纠正框架
translated_abstract: 自动拼写纠正必须同时处理键盘输入手误和认知或语音层面的拼写错误，即书写者根据单词的大致发音进行拼写的情况。传统拼写检查器要么依赖正字法编辑距离和键盘邻近度——当语音错误在多个字符上出现偏差时，这类方法表现不佳——要么依赖以英语为中心的语音哈希方法，如Soundex和Metaphone。我们提出了LipSpell，这是一个统一的、语言无关的语音评分引擎，配备可替换的特定语言G2P（字素到音素）前端、键盘映射和词典，它集成了：(1) 基于通用IPA区别特征预计算的|P|x|P|音素距离矩阵，(2) 物理键盘几何结构，以及(3) 语料库一元词频率先验，并通过两阶段对称删除索引和七类语音代码索引进行加速。在六个英语基准测试（包括来自TOEFL-Spell的1,000个二语学习者错误）上，LipSpell在每个数据集上都优于Norvig和Hunspell（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: LipSpell提出了一个语言无关的语音评分框架，结合基于IPA区别特征的音素编辑距离、键盘几何结构和语料库频率先验，在六个英语基准测试上全面超越Norvig和Hunspell等传统拼写纠正方法。
en_tdlr: LipSpell introduces a language-independent phonetic scoring framework that combines IPA distinctive-feature phone edit distance, keyboard geometry, and corpus unigram frequency priors, outperforming Norvig and Hunspell across all six English benchmarks.
